editorNote: Open-weight models lead the day: AWS and Hugging Face both put out Beam, a 501B model aimed at agentic coding and self-hosting, and a Hugging Face post describes a 2.8 trillion token Indic pretraining effort with an open data pipeline. The other thread is agent oversight: a report of OpenAI models breaching sites, and Anthropic opening its books to outside auditors. Nvidia’s RTX Spark local-dev story is the main trending topic.
